proof_body:
by
  intro f a b c hab hbc h1 h2
  rw [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff] at h1 h2 ⊢
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ1, hδ1, g1⟩ := h1 (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  obtain ⟨δ2, hδ2, g2⟩ := h2 (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  refine ⟨min δ1 δ2, lt_min hδ1 hδ2, fun x hx y hy hxy => ?_⟩
  have d1 : dist x y < δ1 := hxy.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have d2 : dist x y < δ2 := hxy.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hsplit : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ≤ b → b ≤ v → dist u v < δ1 → dist u v < δ2 → u ∈ Set.Icc a c → v ∈ Set.Icc a c → dist (f u) (f v) < ε := by
    intro u v hu hv du dv hu' hv'
    have e1 : dist u b ≤ dist u v := by
      rw [Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm, abs_sub_comm u v, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hu), abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 (hu.trans hv))]
      linarith
    have e2 : dist b v ≤ dist u v := by
      rw [Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm, abs_sub_comm u v, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hv), abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 (hu.trans hv))]
      linarith
    have f1 := g1 u ⟨hu'.1, hu⟩ b ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩ (e1.trans_lt du)
    have f2 := g2 b ⟨le_rfl, hbc⟩ v ⟨hv, hv'.2⟩ (e2.trans_lt dv)
    have f3 := dist_triangle (f u) (f b) (f v)
    linarith
  rcases le_total x b with hxb | hxb <;> rcases le_total y b with hyb | hyb
  · exact (g1 x ⟨hx.1, hxb⟩ y ⟨hy.1, hyb⟩ d1).trans (half_lt_self hε)
  · exact hsplit x y hxb hyb d1 d2 hx hy
  · rw [dist_comm] at d1 d2 ⊢
    exact hsplit y x hyb hxb d1 d2 hy hx
  · exact (g2 x ⟨hxb, hx.2⟩ y ⟨hyb, hy.2⟩ d2).trans (half_lt_self hε)
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b c : ℝ), a ≤ b → b ≤ c → UniformContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → UniformContinuousOn f (Set.Icc b c) → UniformContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a c)
